video_title: Vlade Divac Faked a Lucy Liu Date for a Lakers Rookie… Then Kobe Broke the News

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac orchestrates a long-running prank on Lakers rookie Tony Bobbitt
quotes.excerpt: You got to set it up on because you were seriously seriously involved in this prank.

text_blocks.speaker: Byron Scott
text_blocks.text: You got to set it up on because you were seriously seriously involved in this prank. Number one, what made you think about the prank? Number two, why did you let it go so long? Are you just wanting to see how long he was going to drag it on?

text_blocks.speaker: Vlade Divac
text_blocks.text: I will explain. It started from nowhere. You remember our equipment manager, Rudy? Rudy came to me and we had the two rookies, Sasha Vujacic and Tony Bobbitt. Rudy comes to me and says, Vlade, listen, you got to help me out with those two rookies. They are not listening. Every time we finish practice, those two are first out. I said, okay, I will talk to them. I talked to both of them. I told them you got to help Rudy. We all once were rookies and this is how we do in NBA. Sasha does his part, but Tony does not.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac threatens Tony Bobbitt to commit to the rookie prank
quotes.excerpt: I will make sure you are going to remember with the rest of your life if you don't do this.
quotes.quote: I had to go again and talk to Tony. I said, Tony, I talked to you once, this is the second time. The third time is not going to happen. I will make sure you are going to remember with the rest of your life if you don't do this. He said, I got you Vlade, I got you. But he still does not do it.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac tricks Tony Bobbitt into believing he is dating Lucy Liu
quotes.excerpt: Lucy Liu, the actress, she is across. She is looking at me. I said, okay, have a seat.
quotes.quote: Tony says, Vlade, can I sit down? I said no. He said, come on. He said, Lucy Liu, the actress, she is across. She is looking at me. I said, okay, have a seat. I asked her, can you write a note? She said, hi Tony, this is Lucy Liu, give me a call, and left a number. I gave the note to security, he goes to Tony. I am watching from the angle and I see Tony looking at the paper, putting it in his pocket, so I know he is going to start calling.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac involves John Black in the Lucy Liu prank
quotes.excerpt: I got him involved with John Black. John Black was our PR guy.
quotes.quote: Everybody knew about it. Everybody in the locker room, players, coaches. I got him involved with John Black. John Black was our PR guy. He would text him, hey babe, how are you? I am looking forward to see you.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Lamar Odom gets tired of the Lucy Liu prank
quotes.excerpt: Lamar came to me and said, Vlade, I can't take it anymore. This is ridiculous.
quotes.quote: Lamar and Tony, they were buddies. Lamar came to me and said, Vlade, I can't take it anymore. This is ridiculous. It is going too far. I said, you are right, you are right.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant reveals the Lucy Liu prank to Lamar Odom
quotes.excerpt: Kobe came in, listening to the story, and then Tony said, she kissed me right here.
quotes.quote: Kobe came in, listening to the story, and then Tony said, she kissed me right here. Lamar couldn't believe it. He said, Vlade, keep going.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac uses People magazine to escalate the Lucy Liu prank
quotes.excerpt: I told John Black to make it the cover story of a few people magazine.
quotes.quote: I told John Black to make it the cover story of a few people magazine. So he goes to the office, putting picture of Lucy Liu and Tony. He said, LA romance. He comes down there, he says, what are we going to do with this? And Tony freaked out. You got to stop it, you got to stop it.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac hires a limo driver to record Tony Bobbitt
quotes.excerpt: I hired a limo driver, I told him to put the cameras in and give me a call.
quotes.quote: I hired a limo driver, I told him to put the cameras in and give me a call when he goes in so I can tell everybody that he is in. So everybody starts calling him and he is telling the story in the limo while he was driving to the restaurant.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Bobbitt arrives at the restaurant for his fake date
quotes.excerpt: He arrives to the restaurant where I set up again camera in the restaurant.
quotes.quote: He arrives to the restaurant where I set up again camera in the restaurant. Before he exits the car, he comes back, tell the driver, can you check his paparazzi over there? I was laughing. It was crazy.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Bobbitt gets rejected at the restaurant
quotes.excerpt: The waiter asking him what is his name. He says Tony. We don't have a reservation for you.
quotes.quote: He goes in the restaurant and asking for his table and the waiter asking him what is his name. He says Tony. We don't have a reservation for you. Who you with? And he said Lucy. Oh, of course, she called. This is your table, give him some champagne.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: The entire Lakers team gathers to watch Tony Bobbitt's fake date
quotes.excerpt: The whole team gathered together the place next door. It was the entire team with wives and kids.
quotes.quote: The whole team gathered together the place next door. It was the entire team with wives and kids. 20, 30 people. And we are walking in.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant questions why Tony Bobbitt is calling Lucy Liu
quotes.excerpt: Kobe said, why did you call her? I talked to her, call her right now.
quotes.quote: Kobe said, why did you call her? I talked to her, call her right now. So Tony calls, my phone rings and I am, hi, this is Lucy Liu.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac confronts Tony Bobbitt about the fake date
quotes.excerpt: I said, Tony, do you remember when I told you? Are you going to remember?
quotes.quote: I said, Tony, do you remember when I told you? Are you going to remember?
